title: Keir Starmer announces he is standing down as MP
description: The move will trigger a by-election to replace the former prime minister in his London constituency.

title: Summer 2026 was UK's hottest on record, Met Office says
description: Met Office figures show that the previous record, set in 2025, has been broken after an unprecedented summer of persistent heat.

title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

title: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
description: More than 100 Indians are missing at a vital Nepal-China trade crossing after devastating Himalayan floods.

title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
description: Most migrants have returned to neighbouring Morocco, but as many as 5,000 remain in the Spanish exclave.

title: Norway's Haakon takes oath as mourners pay respects to late King
description: Norway's new King takes the first major step of his reign as his father, the late King Harald V, lies in state at the Royal Palace.

title: Laundry rooms to be turned into cells to tackle prison overcrowding
description: The government says £110m has been fast-tracked from existing budgets to speed up the building of new cells.

title: Man in court charged with murder after deaths of woman and girl in Teesside fire
description: A seven-year-old girl and her aunt died in the fire in Grangetown, near Middlesbrough, on 26 August.

title: Trump says US position on Falklands 'one of many' under review
description: The UK says Falkland islanders "are British with a right to determine their own future".
